verdict.rationale: Mercury's marketing directly claims AI-powered automations that close books faster, alongside QuickBooks, Xero and NetSuite sync. Related AI features back this up: AI bill reading and auto-attaching receipts to card transactions. All of it is homepage-level copy, with no detailed docs describing what the close automations actually do. Missing for 10: documentation of the specific AI close workflows (e.g., auto-categorization or reconciliation into the accounting ledger), details of how the accounting sync works, and independent or hands-on confirmation that close time is reduced.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can use AI automations to close my books faster each month

citations.quote: Sync with Quickbooks, Xero or NetSuite, and save hours with AI-powered automations to close your books faster.
Email or upload receipts and we’ll auto-attach them to the right card transaction.
AI reads bills, populates details automatically, and remembers past recipients
